quote.text: Always remember what is your own and what is not, and you’ll never be troubled. [
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood: Recognize that your role is to nurture and guide, yet understand that each child has their own unique path—acknowledging these limits can prevent undue worry over outcomes beyond your control.
  • Parenthood: Accepting what is yours to shape and what is not empowers you to focus on the present moments with your children, fostering a home of calm and genuine growth.
  • Leadership: A wise leader discerns between responsibilities that lie within their own sphere and those that belong to others, enabling clear delegation and reducing personal stress.
  • Leadership: By keeping a clear boundary between your personal influence and the natural unfolding of team dynamics, you can lead with confidence and maintain inner tranquility.
  • Product Management: Embrace a mindset that distinguishes between factors you control—such as the quality and vision of your product—and external variables like market trends and customer whims.
  • Product Management: This clarity in ownership helps you focus on refining your product strategy, iterate effectively, and remain untroubled by unforeseen challenges that lie beyond your immediate influence.
